newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 11.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Fifty-nine college cooperatives to introduce electronic money.
-- LDP confident of regaining majority in Lower House.
-- Thirteen banks to stop buying publications of "sokaiya" racketeers.
-- Landslide kills at least 19 as torrential rains hit Kyushu. Two still missing in Kagoshima prefecture. -- North Korean defector Hwang says Kim Jong-il sees China as capitalist country.
-- Poll shows 60 percent of Lower House members want to prepare legislation for dealing with national security emergencies.
-- Prosecutors take up case involving Tokaimura nuclear plant accident.
